parameters.name: AIPipelineId
parameters.description:
The AI task pipeline ID.

> A default ID is available, so this parameter is optional. If you need to perform batch imports, use a separate task pipeline. Submit a ticket to request configuration or contact Alibaba Cloud after-sales support for configuration. For more information about how to submit a ticket, see [Contact us](~~464625~~).

parameters.name: AITemplateId
parameters.description:
The AI image template ID. You can obtain the template ID by using one of the following methods:
- When you create an image template by calling the [AddAITemplate](~~102930~~) operation, the template ID is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response.
- After the template is created, you can call the [ListAITemplate](~~102936~~) operation to query the AI image template ID, which is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description:
The custom settings.
- The value must be a JSON string.
- The value must contain the MessageCallback or Extend parameter.
- The maximum length is 512 bytes.

For more information about the parameter structure, see [UserData](~~86952~~).

parameters.name: VideoId
parameters.description:
The video ID. You can obtain the video ID by using one of the following methods:
- For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.
- When you upload a video by calling the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation, the video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
- After the video is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
